get_email_event_settings: get all email event settings from the litellm proxy database via the GET endpoint
update_email_event_settings: update specific email event settings by enabling or disabling events via the PATCH endpoint
reset_email_event_settings: reset all email event settings to their default values via the POST reset endpoint
get_email_settings_helper: retrieve email settings from the general_settings database entry using the prisma client
save_email_settings_helper: save email settings to the general_settings database entry using an upsert operation
